title: SigV4 lifecycle settings
description: Instance-level settings, before an outbound signing binding is selected. Credentials are lent separately. An absent blob is equivalent to {}.

service.description: Optional at lifecycle validation; signing bindings require a non-null value. Surrounding Unicode whitespace is trimmed.

region.description: Optional at lifecycle validation; signing bindings require a non-null value. Surrounding Unicode whitespace is trimmed.

region_unread.description: Host warning about region resolution. Lifecycle accepts any value; the signing binding checks string or null.

content_type.description: Compatibility/provider setting ignored by this plugin; any JSON value is accepted.

token_url.description: Compatibility/provider setting ignored by this plugin; any JSON value is accepted.

token_uri.description: Compatibility/provider setting ignored by this plugin; any JSON value is accepted.

scope.description: Compatibility/provider setting ignored by this plugin; any JSON value is accepted.

subject.description: Compatibility/provider setting ignored by this plugin; any JSON value is accepted.
